moments.title: Worcester Music Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The UK's largest donation-entry festival returns to Worcester from September 11-13, featuring over 350 performances across 25 venues, supporting local charities.

angles.name: Main Event
angles.copy: 350 acts, 25 venues, all for charity. Worcester Music Festival kicks off this weekend, proving live music can do good. Who are you seeing?

angles.name: Local Spotlight
angles.copy: Worcester is buzzing! The city's Music Festival starts Friday, bringing hundreds of artists and raising money for local causes. Support live music and local talent.

moments.title: Mucky Weekender Festival Returns
moments.blurb: Barry Ashworth's Mucky Weekender Festival brings an eclectic mix of live bands, DJs, and performers to 28 acres of private parkland from September 10-12.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Your weekend plans sorted: Mucky Weekender Festival starts tomorrow! Three days of live music and good times. Who's heading there?

angles.name: Dance Music Angle
angles.copy: Getting ready for the Mucky Weekender! Expect an epic lineup of live bands and DJs delivering the best beats all weekend. Let's go!

moments.title: Reminisce Festival Takes Over St Helens
moments.blurb: Reminisce Festival celebrates dance music nostalgia on September 12 at Sherdley Park, St Helens, featuring iconic club artists and DJs from the 90s and 00s.

angles.name: Throwback Party
angles.copy: Hands in the air for Reminisce Festival this Saturday! All the best 90s and 00s dance anthems are taking over St Helens. Who's ready to relive it?

angles.name: Nostalgia Trip
angles.copy: Get ready for a massive dose of nostalgia! Reminisce Festival is bringing back all your favourite 90s and 00s clubland legends this weekend. Which track are you hoping to hear?

moments.title: Little Orchard Festival in Cornwall
moments.blurb: The Little Orchard Festival in Penhallow, Cornwall, runs from September 11-13, offering a mix of Brit Pop bands and a great way to end the festival season.

angles.name: Cornwall Calling
angles.copy: Little Orchard Festival is back in Cornwall this weekend! Great music, great cider, and a brilliant way to see out the summer festival season. Who's joining the fun?

angles.name: Brit Pop Vibes
angles.copy: If you love Brit Pop, get to Little Orchard Festival this weekend! They've got some of the UK's best bands headlining in beautiful Cornwall.

moments.title: Equinox Festival for Grassroots Music
moments.blurb: Equinox Festival, a grassroots music and arts event in Lincolnshire, takes place from September 17-21, featuring live bands, DJs, and workshops.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Just one week until Equinox Festival! Five days of amazing grassroots music, arts, and good vibes in Lincolnshire. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Discover New Music
angles.copy: Looking for something different? Equinox Festival is all about discovering new music and art in a fantastic setting. It starts next Thursday!

moments.title: Ella Langley Still No. 1 on UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' holds the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart for September 4-10, with new entries from Dolly Parton and Sienna Spiro making waves.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at number one! Ella Langley continues her reign on the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Choosin' Texas'. Who's loving this track?

angles.name: Dolly's Chart Impact
angles.copy: Dolly Parton is back in the charts with new entries and re-entries! A true legend proving her timeless appeal. Which Dolly hit is your favourite?

moments.title: New Albums This Week
moments.blurb: Friday, September 11, sees new album releases from artists including indie rock band Bloc Party and Scottish folk-pop duo The Proclaimers.

angles.name: Friday Feeling
angles.copy: New music Friday delivers! Bloc Party drop 'The Anatomy Of A Brief Romance' this week. What are you listening to first?

angles.name: Iconic Returns
angles.copy: The Proclaimers are back with a new album, 'You May Offend', out this Friday! Expect those signature harmonies and catchy tunes.

moments.title: Moby Turns 61
moments.blurb: American electronic musician, singer-songwriter, and DJ Moby, born Richard Melville Hall, celebrates his 61st birthday on September 11.

angles.name: Dance Legend
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the electronic music pioneer, Moby, this Friday! What's your all-time favourite Moby track?

angles.name: Timeless Tracks
angles.copy: From 'Play' to 'Porcelain', Moby's music defined an era. Wishing a very happy 61st to the legend this week!

moments.title: Niall Horan Celebrates 33rd Birthday
moments.blurb: Irish singer-songwriter Niall Horan, formerly of One Direction and now a successful solo artist, turns 33 on September 13.

angles.name: Pop Star Bday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 33rd birthday to Niall Horan this Sunday! What's your favourite solo hit from the former One Direction star?

angles.name: One Direction Flashback
angles.copy: Remembering the One Direction days as Niall Horan turns 33 this weekend! From boyband sensation to solo success, he's had quite the journey.

moments.title: Heritage Open Days Across England
moments.blurb: England's Heritage Open Days run from September 11-20, offering free access to thousands of historic buildings and cultural sites usually closed to the public.

angles.name: Explore History
angles.copy: Unlock hidden history! Heritage Open Days kick off this Friday across England, giving you free access to incredible places. What will you discover?

angles.name: Free Adventures
angles.copy: Fancy a free day out? From historic houses to hidden gardens, Heritage Open Days offer unique experiences across England starting this week.

moments.title: Open Doors Wales Continues
moments.blurb: Throughout September, Open Doors Wales offers free access to over 200 historic sites, landmarks, and hidden gems across the country.

angles.name: Welsh Heritage
angles.copy: Explore Wales for free! Open Doors Wales is running all month, giving you access to historic sites and hidden gems. Where are you visiting?

angles.name: Discover Dragonland
angles.copy: From ancient castles to local treasures, Open Doors Wales lets you explore our history for free this September. Get out and discover something new!

moments.title: Totally Thames Festival in Full Swing
moments.blurb: London's Totally Thames Festival continues throughout September, celebrating the iconic river with art installations, boat races, performances, and cultural events.

angles.name: London River Life
angles.copy: The Thames is alive with activity! Totally Thames Festival is in full swing all September with art, music, and events along the river. What's caught your eye?

angles.name: Cultural Immersion
angles.copy: From boat races to art on the banks, Totally Thames Festival offers a unique way to experience London's famous river this month.

moments.title: London Design & Open House Festivals Begin
moments.blurb: The London Design Festival and Open House Festival both run from September 12-20, showcasing the city's creativity and offering rare access to iconic buildings.

angles.name: Design & Architecture
angles.copy: Two huge events kick off this weekend in London! The Design Festival and Open House Festival are your chance to explore incredible architecture and creativity across the city.

angles.name: Hidden Gems
angles.copy: Ever wanted to peek inside London's most famous or secret buildings? Open House Festival starts Saturday, offering free access to hundreds of sites!

moments.title: Abergavenny Food Festival Returns
moments.blurb: The Abergavenny Food Festival, known for its tastings, chef demos, and workshops, takes place from September 19-20 in Wales.

angles.name: Foodie Heaven
angles.copy: Get ready, food lovers! The Abergavenny Food Festival is back next weekend with incredible tastings, chef demos, and a Party in the Castle. Who's hungry?

angles.name: Taste of Wales
angles.copy: Celebrate the best of Welsh produce at the Abergavenny Food Festival starting next Saturday! It's two days of deliciousness and fun.

moments.title: Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival Starts
moments.blurb: Tulleys Farm in West Sussex launches its popular Pumpkin Festival on September 19, featuring over a million pumpkins, seasonal food, and entertainment until October 31.

angles.name: Autumn Fun
angles.copy: Pumpkin season officially begins next Saturday! Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival kicks off with over a million pumpkins and autumnal fun. Who's ready for carving?

angles.name: Family Day Out
angles.copy: Planning a family day out? Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival starts next weekend in West Sussex, offering loads of seasonal food and entertainment.
